title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Employing Suspended Licensees
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal is looking to hire a law clerk. An applicant reveals they are an LSO-licensed paralegal currently suspended for professional misconduct. Can the paralegal hire this person to do administrative work?
options: Yes, as long as they are only doing filing and answering phones.
Yes, but they must be paid below minimum wage.
No, a licensee cannot employ or retain a person who is suspended or disbarred by the LSO without explicit approval from a panel of the Law Society Tribunal.
No, suspended licensees must be reported to the police.
questions.explain: Under Rule 6.01, a paralegal shall not, without the express approval of a panel of the Hearing Division of the Law Society Tribunal, employ, retain, or associate in practice with an individual who has been disbarred, suspended, or had their license revoked.
